messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV-2 alert: increased rollout errors for rollout_id=rl-2026-03-archv2 at 12:07 UTC. Error rate spike on canary variant, auto-fallbacks observed. Paging @sara (oncall) and @mike (sre).

sara (oncall): ack. looking. any initial impact numbers?

incident-bot: Current metrics: canary error rate 18% (baseline 0.3%), tail latency p95 -> 1100ms, fallback rate -> 27% to regional fallback. Affected region: eu-west-1 primarily. Customers with sticky routing show degraded outputs.

mike (sre): on my way. tagging @laura for customer impact visibility. quick hypothesis: rollout uses smart-routing policy 'canary-rollout-v2' that fell back to variant 'gptx-2-quant-small' instead of 'gptx-2-quant-large' because of a label mismatch in the variant map. sticky routing then kept requests on the failing fallback in some sessions.

laura (product): which customers are affected? do we have errors that show hallucination/regression or just latency/errors?

incident-bot: Affected routes: /generate-chat and /batch-embed. Top two customers: AcmeCorp (customer_id=acm-42) and VocaLabs (vl-7). Error types: 503s from model container on the fallback variant and degraded semantic quality reports for chat (quality score down -12% on canary prompts).

sara (oncall): can we reproduce? mike, can you dump the routing policy config?

mike (sre): pasting relevant snippet:

```
policy: canary-rollout-v2
variants:
  - name: gptx-2-quant-large
    tags: [stable, large]
  - name: gptx-2-quant-small
    tags: [canary, small]
fallback:
  region_map:
    eu-west-1: gptx-2-quant-small  # <-- should be gptx-2-quant-large
sticky: true
```

mike (sre): yep, that region_map entry was mis-typed during recent policy edit. that means when the canary failed, fallback in eu-west pointed to the small canary variant, causing cascading fail/quality loop.

sara (oncall): ok immediate plan: 1) pause rollout (canary) 2) correct region fallback mapping 3) force sticky sessions to re-evaluate (clear sticky token in routing for affected sessions) 4) monitor customer error/quality. mike, can you run pause?

mike (sre): running command: `redwood rollout pause --id rl-2026-03-archv2 && redwood policy update canary-rollout-v2 --patch-file -`

ops-bot: Command executed by mike: `rollout paused` (rl-2026-03-archv2). Reason: emergency rollback pause.

mike (sre): patch to apply (pasting):

```
- op: replace
  path: /fallback/region_map/eu-west-1
  value: gptx-2-quant-large
```

mike (sre): applying patch...

ops-bot: Policy update accepted. New policy version canary-rollout-v2@v17 created.

sara (oncall): now need to invalidate sticky assignments for affected sessions. we can do a targeted TTL flush for sticky cookies for AcmeCorp and VocaLabs. mike do we have a command?

mike (sre): yes: `redwood routing flush-sticky --org acm-42 --routes /generate-chat,/batch-embed --region eu-west-1` and same for vl-7. running for acm-42 first.

ops-bot: Sticky flush started for acm-42. 1.2k sessions queued, estimated completion 45s.

laura (product): I'll notify AcmeCorp and VocaLabs support leads with a short heads-up saying we detected routing regressions, we paused the canary and are fixing policy mapping; asking them to open a ticket if they see further regressions.

sara (oncall): watching metrics. initial error rate dropping: overall error -> 5% (was 18%), fallback rate down to 6%. p95 latency trending down to 420ms. quality signals: partial improvement but we should keep targeted evals running.

mike (sre): sticky flush finished for acm-42. now running for vl-7.

ops-bot: Sticky flush completed for vl-7. 800 sessions cleared.

mike (sre): vl-7 error rate back to baseline. running additional checks: container logs show OOMs on gptx-2-quant-small under certain request sizes which explains 503s. Good we redirected to large variant.

laura (product): customer outreach message drafted and posted to their workspace. no escalations yet.

sara (oncall): status update for pager: incident status -> mitigated (partial). Impact: degraded quality and increased errors for two customers in eu-west-1 during canary window. Actions taken: paused rollout, corrected fallback mapping, cleared sticky sessions, monitoring. Postmortem assigned to eng-runtime + product.

mike (sre): follow-ups: 1) add validation to policy changes to catch label mismatches 2) add canary to policy-change pipeline so changes to fallback map generate dry-run metrics 3) make sticky rebind non-destructive (graceful re-eval) in case of fallback flips.

laura (product): adding customer impact notes to incident tracker. recommend delaying canary resume until we have a canary-run with synthetic evals passing and 24h of stable metrics.

sara (oncall): handing to mike for post-incident follow-up. mike, you're the incident owner for the PM. I'll mark the on-call shift handover in the incident doc.

mike (sre): taking it. I'll open the postmortem draft and ping runtime and devex. closing channel notification in 30m unless new regressions pop. :white_check_mark:
